svg.title: A bucket on another guest: every cycle, on a scale of powers of ten
svg.desc: Two panels plot every one of 51 cycles with the bucket on a second guest. With no shaping, a request to an actor of 1,000 MiB took a median of 12.2 s to its first 200. At 20 Mbit/s, an actor of 200 MiB took 87.8 s, and its synchronous suspend took 88.5 s. In 26 cycles the first answer was a 504 after 10 s, and a later request returned 200.
svg.text: the path from the node to the bucket on the other guest
the number above a group is the MiB of data in the actor
